rule: The lowest measured GPU median for the exact BF16 elementwise operation was N=1: g1-sg0-l0-b0-p0-n1-split1-burst1 (0.5210 us GPU median); N=32: g1-sg1-l0-b1-p0-n32-split1-burst1 (0.5210 us GPU median); N=640: g2-sg0-l0-b0-p1-n640-split1-burst1 (0.6250 us GPU median); N=2560: g2-sg1-l0-b0-p1-n2560-split1-burst1 (0.7290 us GPU median); N=6400: g2-sg0-l0-b1-p1-n6400-split1-burst1 (0.7290 us GPU median); N=10240: g2-sg1-l0-b0-p1-n10240-split1-burst1 (0.7290 us GPU median); N=25600: g3-sg0-l1-b0-p1-n25600-split1-burst1 (0.7290 us GPU median). This rule applies to these measured trivial independent elements; a kernel with reductions, dependencies, or a different body still requires its own byte and timing gate. Host-wall medians include submission and wait, GPU-event sums exclude launch gaps; burst rows separately test whether 1,000 consecutive submissions amortize host and event costs.
